institutional_candidates.claim: BNY says its Digital Asset Custody platform supports XRP and RLUSD; BNY is RLUSD's primary reserve custodian; direct mint/redeem and expanded tokenized-asset support are intended future capabilities subject to approvals.

OCC Corporate Applications Search lists Ripple National Trust Bank, application 2025-Charter-342347, approved Dec 12 2025 and consummated/effective Oct 26 2026. This does not establish that every banking activity is live.

Ripple says RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood, expected later in the Robinhood app, and intended for institutional settlement on XRPL; the announcement also covers Ripple Treasury and Ripple Prime. Actual production volume and XRP bridge usage remain unmeasured.

Ripple announced always-on corporate treasury orchestration and a 24/7 Returns capability for eligible digital assets including RLUSD. Actual customer balances, flows and realized returns were not measured.

Ripple/DriveWealth describe planned RLUSD settlement on XRPL in Europe with US expansion planned, custody integration, stablecoin funding of collateral accounts and exploration of equity financing through Ripple Prime. Announced plans are not measured production flows.

RLUSD trading/management announced for Coinbase Prime, Exchange and retail, with XRPL/Base/Ethereum deposit-withdrawal support; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral availability was described as future rollout.

Ripple's announcement states RLUSD market capitalization exceeded $2.5B and more than $1B was issued on XRPL; issuer-reported metrics require independent supply/circulation corroboration. C2FO's $520B refers to historical working-capital programs, not XRPL volume.

Ripple reports a $900M annualized product-revenue run rate, $16T in transactions enabled across products in 2025, 1,700+ institutional/corporate/enterprise clients and 3x growth in customers/partners using multiple solutions. These are company-reported claims, not independently audited XRP flow data.
